purpose: Prevent correlated pixel detectors from being counted as independent evidence while keeping every displayed card contribution auditable.

pixel_family_fusion.strongest_positive_component: Keeps its registered high or limited contribution.
pixel_family_fusion.additional_positive_components: Share a combined corroboration budget allocated in proportion to their registered contributions.
pixel_family_fusion.allocation_rounding: Integer largest-remainder allocation with stable detector ordering.

global_displayed_score_bound.invariant: Displayed card contributions sum to the signed score shown in the ring.
global_displayed_score_bound.rationale: When the positive range is exhausted, weaker visual evidence is reduced before stronger independent provenance so card totals cannot exceed the ring.

validation.required_invariant: The sum of displayed score_components always equals ai_score, including when verified evidence reaches the global signed bound.

limitations: This policy is a conservative dependency correction, not a calibrated probability model.
The 20-point corroboration budget is an engineering bound and must be replaced or revalidated if a joint fusion model passes an independent held-out evaluation.
Pixel detectors can still share unknown training or preprocessing biases even after the dependency discount.
A negative or absent pixel signal is not evidence of camera origin.
